vn-local.summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，四項既有痛點持續：鋼價十月下半月同步上漲，壓縮獲利；出口製造業被要求提升國內附加價值、切入全球供應鏈；GRECO 2026展出人形與服務機器人，自動化需求升溫。Nike等推出零直排電動駁船，顯示出口供應鏈減碳要求正落地。勞工短缺與技能不足也列為上升痛點。
vn-local.summary_en: No new pains today. Steel prices rose in late October, squeezing margins. Exporters are urged to raise local value-add in global supply chains. GRECO 2026 showcased robots as automation demand rises. Nike's zero-emission e-barge signals supply-chain decarbonisation. Labour shortage and skills gaps are rising.
highlights: 勞工短缺，留住現有員工成本增加
工廠需導入機器人，提升自動化產能
缺乏實作技能與外語能力的勞工，難以配合自動化

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日VN華商層面有3則相關消息：中國承包商拿下同奈省約8.33億美元礬土加工廠EPC工程；國會審議《土地法（修正案）》與《中小企業發展法》草案，涉及土地價格表調整；國際能源署呼籲擴大CCUS，越南同步加快工業減排。減碳合規壓力（P040）持續上升，外籍員工工作許可核對（P069）亦升溫，華商需留意土地成本與ESG合規。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Three items today: a Chinese contractor won a ~US$833M EPC deal for a Dong Nai alumina plant; the National Assembly is reviewing Land Law amendments and an SME law draft, including land price tables; the IEA urges scaling CCUS as Vietnam speeds industrial emission cuts. Decarbonisation pressure (P040) keeps rising.
highlights: 綠色轉型要求提高，減碳合規壓力增加
外籍員工工作許可需定期核對
綠色轉型要求提高，減碳合規壓力增加

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國今日焦點：商務部與10個鋼鐵協會研議反傾銷措施，8個月鋼材進口達798,584噸；工業聯合會與14家車廠推動新消費稅制以提高本地含量，製造商貿易合規與供應鏈在地化壓力上升。同時NetSuite以Agentic AI縮短ERP導入時間，Fuji測試大型晶片自動化SMT組裝，反映數位化與產線自動化需求。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand weighs anti-dumping steps after 798,584 tonnes of steel imports in 8 months, while FTI and 14 carmakers push a new excise scheme to raise local content. NetSuite claims AI cuts ERP go-live to weeks, and Fuji tests automated SMT for 1.3 kg chips, signaling compliance and automation needs.
highlights: ERP導入週期長，上線時間難以縮短
鋼材進口激增，反傾銷與貿易合規壓力增加
大型重型元件SMT組裝困難，產線自動化需求增加

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日泰國華商動態聚焦擴產與高階認證：jpp-KY經寶精密通過空中巴士關鍵特殊製程驗證，並因AI與航太訂單預估明年營收雙位數成長、將加大泰國投資；海爾投資52.5億銖於羅勇府建洗衣機廠；泰國副總理亦率中國投資者考察宋卡府，評估無人機與機器人生產基地。顯示客戶對海外產能與嚴格品質驗證的要求同步升高。
th-huashang.summary_en: Chinese-owned makers deepen Thailand bets: jpp-KY passed Airbus special-process validation and will expand Thai investment on AI/aerospace orders; Haier invests THB5.25bn in a Rayong washer plant; Chinese investors eye Songkhla for drones and robotics. Overseas capacity and strict certification matter.
highlights: 高階客戶認證門檻高，特殊製程需完整驗證
客戶要求海外產能，需支援跨國生產

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日新浮現痛點：16家越南企業透過智慧工廠顧問計畫提升生產效率，顯示中小製造業升級需求。成本壓力仍是主軸，VinEnergo直接供電VinFast工廠以節省電費；VINATech整併三座工廠、Geleximco與Chery合建汽車廠，凸顯擴張時數據與流程統一的挑戰。
vn-local.summary_en: 16 Vietnamese firms raised productivity via a smart-factory consulting program, a new SME upgrade signal. Cost pressure persists: VinEnergo now powers VinFast plants directly to cut power bills. VINATech's three-plant consolidation highlights multi-site data and process unification.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日焦點：華碩、宏碁、惠普因AI推升零組件成本，將部分PC生產從泰國與越南遷回中國大陸，越南華商需重新評估代工產能布局與成本。越南第393/2026號法令將於12月5日生效，規範外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）工作許可延期流程；滅火器造假案則凸顯供應商原料與進料檢驗風險。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Asus, Acer and HP are moving some PC output from Thailand and Vietnam back to mainland China as AI lifts component costs, prompting capacity reassessment. Decree 393/2026 on work permit extensions for foreign workers in Vietnam takes effect Dec 5; a fire extinguisher fraud case flags supplier quality risk.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點：工廠投資增加但就業減少，自動化下人才轉型壓力持續升溫；中小企業協會警告柴油漲價推高運輸與生產成本。另寵物食品OEM廠被鼓勵轉型自有品牌以提升出口價值，汽車廠則在東部洪水退去後加速復產，顯示產能與交期韌性仍是關鍵。
th-local.summary_en: Thai factories invest more but hire fewer, raising pressure to reskill for automation and AI. SMEs warn rising diesel prices lift transport and production costs. Pet-food OEMs are urged to build own brands, while automakers speed output after eastern floods recede.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 政府要求研議自11月1日起調降平均零售電價，Agribank與VietinBank也下調生產經營貸款利率（低至年息6%），有助緩解製造業能源與融資成本壓力。同時，湄公河三角洲缺工持續，勞工表示若家鄉有工業區職缺便願留鄉；AI將工程圖轉為生產指令、本地企業切入FDI供應鏈等議題也受關注。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam plans to study cutting retail electricity prices from Nov 1, and Agribank and VietinBank cut production loan rates (as low as 6%/yr), easing cost pressure. Mekong Delta labour shortages persist, while AI drawing-to-instruction tools and FDI supply chain entry draw attention.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日峴港公安突擊檢查工業區工地，查獲26名中國籍人員無工作許可證，提醒華商定期核對外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）的工作許可。同塔省多家企業投資屋頂太陽能以符合出口綠色標準，減碳合規壓力持續上升；另有AI工具將工程圖轉生產指令時間由45小時縮至45秒，關稅調整議題也持續升溫。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Da Nang police found 26 Chinese nationals without work permits at industrial park sites, a reminder to check foreign workers' permits regularly. Dong Thap firms adopt rooftop solar to meet green export standards, and an AI tool cuts drawing-to-instruction time from 45 hours to 45 seconds.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國9月汽車產量受洪水衝擊年減6.08%，天災停工首度成為新痛點，產能與交期管理受考驗；國內銷售年增14.28%，主要來自電動車。工業部將自11月2日起稽查1,500家廢棄物工廠，環保合規壓力持續升高。東部經濟走廊委員會另批准4個新投資區，總額256.6億泰銖。
th-local.summary_en: Floods cut Thai September auto output 6.08% YoY, making disaster-driven stoppages a new pain for capacity and delivery planning. From Nov 2 the Industry Ministry will inspect 1,500 waste factories, raising compliance pressure. The EEC approved 4 new investment zones worth THB 25.66bn.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點：一家未具名企業訂購1,000台中國產工業機器人，當地機器人市場預估年增近13%，自動化需求浮現；Agribank降息最多2.0%/年，可望緩解長期偏高的融資成本。另腰果原料進口值已超過出口值，加工利潤受壓；Lê Minh Xuân擴建工業區近100公頃擬轉為社會住宅用地，廠房擴建空間恐受限。
vn-local.summary_en: An unnamed firm ordered 1,000 Chinese industrial robots as Vietnam's robot market eyes ~13% annual growth. Agribank cut lending rates by up to 2.0%/yr, easing financing costs. Cashew raw imports now exceed exports, squeezing margins, and ~100 ha of industrial land may shift to social housing.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南華商製造業面臨三項新痛點：越南首座晶片廠恐難達成明年試產目標、尚未敲定ASML設備採購；第292/2026號法令規範暫時進口再出口許可申請；第283號法令自9月10日起加重勞安罰則，企業最高罰1.5億越盾。同時喬山北寧廠已啟用，關稅調整與減碳合規壓力持續升溫，顯示投資擴張與合規管理需同步強化。
vn-huashang.summary_en: New pains for Chinese-owned makers in Vietnam: the first chip fab may miss next year's trial run with ASML gear unconfirmed, Decree 292/2026 sets temporary import/re-export permit rules, and Decree 283 raises safety fines to VND150m. Tariff and decarbonisation pressure keeps rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在投資與供應鏈調整：BOI前9個月投資額逾1.7兆泰銖、年增28%，EEC新增4個特別經濟促進區；本田計畫委託三菱於林查班工廠代工皮卡，反映代工夥伴擴增、產能配置需調整。另南奔府中小企業支持將大型零售商農產品付款期限限制在30天內，顯示現金流仍是關注重點。
th-local.summary_en: Thai investment momentum continues: BOI pledges topped THB1.7tn in 9 months (+28%) and the EEC added 4 special promotion zones. Honda will outsource pickup production to Mitsubishi at Laem Chabang, signalling OEM capacity shifts. SMEs backed a 30-day payment cap on large retailers to ease cash flow.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南在地製造業出現新痛點：出入境管理部門突擊檢查某工業區企業，並表示將加強後續查核與違規處理，聘有外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）的工廠需盡快檢視人資合規。另外，歐洲航太零件商 ASCO 擬在峴港投資約2,000萬美元設廠，未來可能增至1億美元；Victoria's Secret 合作代工廠在海防與興安約有2.9萬名員工，越南廠貢獻其營收83%，顯示外資持續深化在越生產。
vn-local.summary_en: New pain today: immigration authorities raided a firm in an industrial zone and will step up checks, so plants employing foreign workers in Vietnam should review compliance. ASCO plans a $20M (up to $100M) aerospace parts plant in Da Nang; a Victoria's Secret supplier's Vietnam plants make 83% of its revenue.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅1則相關消息：海防市表示將加強外籍勞工（在越南工作的外國人）管理，並推動物流、工業與進出口發展，派駐台籍、陸籍幹部的華商廠應留意人資合規。今日無新增或重複痛點；近期上升痛點以關稅調整影響出口成本與接單（7次）居首，其次為減碳合規與產能人力不足。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Light day: one item. Hai Phong says it will tighten management of foreign workers in Vietnam while promoting logistics, industry and import-export, so Chinese-owned plants with expat staff should watch HR compliance. No new pains; rising: tariff costs (7), decarbonisation, capacity/labour.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國總理強調外資須進行技術轉移並提升勞工技能，並稱上半年FDI成長約30%，呼應自動化投資增加但人才技能升級不足的持續痛點。另五十鈴推出2.2 Biturbo新引擎，稱國內零件使用率逾90%，顯示在地供應鏈深化。今日僅2則來自單一來源的報導，訊號有限。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's PM urged foreign investors to transfer technology and upskill workers, citing ~30% H1 FDI growth, echoing the recurring automation-vs-skills gap pain. Isuzu launched a new 2.2 Biturbo engine with over 90% local parts. Only 2 items from one source today.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南修訂投資法，目標簡化投資程序並強化供應鏈實質化，回應擴廠審批繁瑣的新痛點；Agribank下調現有貸款利率最多2.5%，緩解持續升溫的融資成本壓力。湄公河三角洲缺工、自動化技能人才不足仍是製造業持續面對的人力挑戰。
vn-local.summary_en: Vietnam is amending its Investment Law to simplify procedures, addressing a new pain on slow expansion approvals. Agribank cut existing loan rates by up to 2.5%, easing rising financing costs. Labour shortages in the Mekong Delta and automation skill gaps persist.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，三項既有痛點持續升溫：成衣大廠儒鴻訂單能見度已達明年第二季，產能與人力壓力浮現；美國調整對加拿大關稅範圍，鋼價升至多年新高，牽動採購成本。越南修訂投資法轉向重視技術轉讓與質量，日本FDI推動綠色轉型，華商需提早因應減碳合規。
vn-huashang.summary_en: No new pains; three recurring ones rose. Eclat's order visibility reaches Q2 next year, straining capacity and labour. US tariff changes on Canada pushed steel to multi-year highs. Vietnam's investment law revision favours quality and tech transfer, while Japanese FDI drives green transition.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅2則相關新聞。CPF主張泰國食品業應以AI提升附加價值與生產力，而非只追求產量，帶出新痛點P057；另有一處橡膠園改建為約1,300億泰銖的工業區，第三期開發瞄準全球供應鏈，顯示產業用地與供應鏈布局持續擴張。
th-local.summary_en: Only 2 relevant items today. CPF urged Thai food makers to use AI to raise value and productivity, not just volume (new pain P057). A rubber plantation is becoming a ~THB 130bn industrial estate, with phase 3 targeting global supply chains.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在擴廠投資與資金成本：Carlsberg計畫2026至2031年投資約6,500萬美元於富白啤酒廠，推動生產現代化與數位、綠色轉型；Biel Crystal再投資近5億美元擴建海防廠。MB銀行最多降息2%/年，緩解融資壓力；湄公河三角洲則出現新痛點：缺乏具實作與外語能力、能配合自動化的勞工。
vn-local.summary_en: Expansion and financing dominate: Carlsberg plans ~US$65M for Phu Bai brewery modernisation with digital and green transition; Biel Crystal adds ~US$500M in Hai Phong. MB cuts loan rates up to 2%/yr. New pain: Mekong Delta lacks skilled, foreign-language workers for automated factories.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日越南華商製造業重點：北寧省兩大工業園區突擊檢查11家企業，8家因環境違規遭罰逾11億越南盾，減碳與環保合規壓力持續升溫。香港Biel Crystal再投資近5億美元擴建海防廠，國會同時審議投資法、企業所得稅法修正草案，影響在越投資與稅務規劃。關稅調整議題亦持續升溫。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Bac Ninh inspected 11 firms in two industrial parks; 8 were fined over VND1.1bn for environmental violations, raising compliance pressure. Biel Crystal adds ~US$500m in Hai Phong, and the National Assembly is reviewing Investment and CIT law amendments. Tariff concerns keep rising.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國工業部派出50組團隊突擊檢查5府1,500家工廠，違規者可能遭勒令停工或吊銷許可，環保稽查壓力持續升高。另有Credit Term新規將於11月2日生效，付款期限上限為30天（農產品）或45天（商業、生產與服務），企業需重新檢視現金流。農業部則支持碾米廠推動稻穀大數據與統一標準。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry sent 50 teams to inspect 1,500 factories in 5 provinces, with possible shutdowns or licence revocation. New credit-term rules take effect Nov 2, capping payment at 30 days (agri) or 45 days (commerce, production, services). Rice mills get backing for paddy big data and unified standards.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在融資與綠色轉型：Techcombank、越南外貿銀行推出生產經營優惠信貸，回應持續升溫的融資成本痛點。綠色基礎設施成為工業區選址要件，機電與紡織回收業面臨新標準壓力；湄公河三角洲勞工短缺推高留才成本，機器人取代組裝人力需求升高。
vn-local.summary_en: Banks (Techcombank, Vietcombank) rolled out lower-rate production loans as financing costs stay a top pain. Green infrastructure is becoming a site-selection criterion, while mechanical-electrical and textile recycling face green standards. Mekong labour shortages raise retention costs and automation demand.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南與EFTA四國於10月18日正式簽署VEFTA自貿協定，削減關稅並打開高購買力市場，但華商須符合原產地與可追溯要求，關稅與接單策略議題持續升溫。另越南國會討論增設7月27日為法定帶薪假（仍屬建議階段），可能影響生產排程與出勤；原料依賴進口的供應不穩問題亦持續出現。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam signed the VEFTA FTA with four EFTA states on Oct 18, cutting tariffs but requiring rules-of-origin and traceability compliance. A proposed new paid holiday on July 27 (still a proposal) may affect scheduling, while import-dependent raw material supply remains a recurring pain.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國出口預估2026年成長17.8%、2027年放緩至7.4%，BOI力推AI伺服器、PCB與EMS供應鏈及五大產業轉型。正大集團、CIIM等與政府合作培育AI與數據工程人才，凸顯自動化投資下的技能缺口；工業總會則指成本持續攀升。蘋果擴增iPhone 18 Pro零組件夥伴，代工廠需重新調整產能配置。
th-local.summary_en: Thai exports forecast +17.8% in 2026, slowing to 7.4% in 2027; BOI pushes AI server, PCB and EMS supply chains. Talent programs target automation skill gaps, costs keep rising, and Apple adding iPhone 18 Pro component partners means suppliers must rethink capacity allocation.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點仍在原料供應：紡織業原輔料瓶頸限制自貿協定紅利，海運運費上漲推高成本。越南與EFTA協定帶來新市場，但要求品質與永續供應鏈；塑膠業與工業場域儲能顯示綠色轉型持續推進。外資加碼半導體封測，供應鏈多元化帶來高附加價值投資機會。
vn-local.summary_en: Raw material bottlenecks remain the key issue: textile input shortages limit FTA gains, and soaring freight lifts costs. The Vietnam–EFTA deal opens markets but demands quality and sustainable supply chains, while plastics and industrial solar-storage show green transition advancing.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國今日：50億泰銖有機肥投資因法規審批受阻，部分工廠已關閉；商業部要求業者在能源與運輸成本上升下緩漲價，壓縮製造商利潤。環保稽查與廢棄物管控持續升溫，化學廢棄物再利用成為話題；雀巢則投資230億泰銖興建新咖啡廠，顯示投資仍在進行。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand: regulatory delays stalled a THB5bn organic fertiliser investment and closed some plants; the Commerce Ministry urges producers to hold prices despite rising energy and transport costs. Environmental compliance pressure keeps rising, while Nestlé breaks ground on a THB23bn coffee plant.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：加高電子於法說會表示泰國新廠已啟用，以滿足客戶海外生產需求，並聚焦AI光通訊、智慧眼鏡與智慧汽車應用。這反映客戶要求海外產能的壓力，正推動台商在泰國建立跨國生產能力，跨廠協同與管理需求隨之浮現。
th-huashang.summary_en: Only one relevant item today: Kaikao Electronics said its new Thailand plant is operational to meet customers' overseas production needs, focusing on AI optical communication, smart glasses and smart vehicles. Customer demand for overseas capacity is pushing cross-border production in Thailand.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在供應鏈門檻升級：越南-EFTA協定要求更嚴格的品質與永續標準，中國擬管制12項太陽能設備技術出口，原料與設備取得風險升高。同時本地企業切入外資供應鏈（瑞士支持、廣寧建資料庫）與融資成本（HDBank降息信貸）持續受關注，Casumina因成本與財務費用大增而虧損。
vn-local.summary_en: Supply-chain bars rose today: Vietnam-EFTA FTA favors chains meeting stricter quality and sustainability rules, while China plans export curbs on 12 solar equipment technologies. Linking local firms to FDI chains and high financing costs stay hot; Casumina posted a loss on surging costs.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 越南與歐洲自由貿易聯盟（EFTA）於10月18日簽署自貿協定，涵蓋關稅、服務與投資，關稅調整對出口成本與接單策略的影響持續升溫。同時胡志明市舉辦機電業綠色轉型研討會，減碳合規成為華商製造業新增痛點，經營與ESG部門需及早因應。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Vietnam signed an FTA with EFTA on Oct 18 covering tariffs, services and investment, keeping tariff-driven export cost and order strategy concerns rising. A HCMC seminar on green transformation in the mechanical-electrical sector flags carbon compliance as a new pain for Chinese-owned manufacturers.

th-local.summary_zh: 泰國政府加速處理普拉恰武里石油外洩，將嚴格管控高風險工廠，環保稽查壓力持續上升（P034）。另有大型民企示警AI投資增加但招聘有限，人才技能升級成新痛點；BOI則推動資料中心與AI供應鏈承接全球投資。製造商需同步強化排放管控與人才轉型。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand is tightening control of high-risk factories after the Prachinburi oil spill, so environmental enforcement pressure keeps rising. Big firms warn AI investment outpaces hiring and urge faster reskilling. BOI pushes data centers and the AI supply chain to capture global investment.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日沒有新的相關文章。

vn-local.summary_zh: 越南國家銀行要求銀行對生產經營貸款降息1.5–2%，VietinBank、LPBank、Sacombank已跟進，融資成本壓力可望緩解。同時政府要求外資加強與本地企業連結，Vingroup以租金減半吸引本土供應商。LION電纜導入SAP Cloud ERP統一數據流程，顯示擴張中的管理整合需求。
vn-local.summary_en: SBV urged banks to cut production loan rates 1.5–2%; VietinBank, LPBank and Sacombank followed, easing financing pressure. Vietnam pushes FDI–local linkages, with Vingroup halving land rent for local suppliers. LION Cable's SAP Cloud ERP rollout shows data unification needs when scaling.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 瑞軒光通訊產品線通過客戶認證，將在越南廠區招募人才並擴產，凸顯訂單增加後產能與人力跟不上的新挑戰。越南與歐洲自由貿易聯盟四國簽署自貿協定，關稅調整議題持續升溫，影響華商出口成本與接單策略。
vn-huashang.summary_en: Amtran's optical communication line passed customer certification and will hire and expand at its Vietnam plant, highlighting capacity and staffing strain. Vietnam signed an FTA with the four EFTA states, keeping tariff shifts affecting export costs and order strategy in focus.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點在環保稽查：普拉千武府一工廠被查出囤放逾1,200噸電子廢棄物並侵占森林保留區，居民發起1,300人連署要求關廠清運，顯示廢棄物與排放管控壓力升高，製造商需強化合規追蹤。另BOI支持豐田14.9億泰銖氫能Hilux投資案。
th-local.summary_en: Thailand: a Prachinburi factory was found storing 1,200+ tonnes of e-waste on forest reserve land, and residents are gathering 1,300 signatures to close it, signaling stricter environmental scrutiny. Separately, BOI backed Toyota's THB1.49bn hydrogen Hilux investment.

th-huashang.summary_zh: 今日三則報導聚焦同一事件：中國車企大舉赴泰國設廠，中國電動車在泰市占率四年內從趨近於零升至逾八成（一則報導為85%）。這顯示中資車廠正快速在泰落地，與TH華商製造業的布局動向直接相關。今日無新增或延續的痛點資料。
th-huashang.summary_en: All three items cover one story: Chinese automakers are building plants in Thailand en masse, and Chinese EVs' Thai market share rose from near zero to over 80% (one report says 85%) in four years. This is relevant to Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand. No pain data today.

vn-local.summary_zh: 今日僅有兩則來自thanhnien.vn的新訊號：越南FDI流入創新高，但本土企業融入外資供應鏈的程度仍不足；同時政府要求銀行將生產與優先領域貸款利率調降1.5至2個百分點。對製造商而言，這代表切入外資供應鏈的機會與門檻並存，融資成本壓力則可能稍獲緩解。
vn-local.summary_en: Two new signals from thanhnien.vn: record FDI inflows, yet local firms remain weakly linked to foreign-invested supply chains; and the government asked banks to cut lending rates for production and priority sectors by 1.5–2 points. Supply-chain entry and financing costs are today's focus.

vn-huashang.summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：越南與四個非歐盟歐洲國家於河內簽署自由貿易協定，相互取消或降低工業、海產及農產品關稅。對在越華商製造業而言，這可能改變出口成本結構與接單策略，財務與業務部門宜及早評估新市場機會。
vn-huashang.summary_en: One relevant item today: Vietnam signed an FTA in Hanoi with four non-EU European countries, cutting or removing tariffs on industrial, seafood and farm goods. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Vietnam, this may reshape export costs and order strategy.

th-local.summary_zh: 今日泰國在地層僅有一則訊息，沒有新增或持續中的痛點。EASTERN ELECTRONICS (THAILAND) 在春武里府阿瑪塔城工業區招聘中英泰口譯人員，屬單一人資招聘消息，尚不足以判斷趨勢。
th-local.summary_en: A quiet day for the Thailand layer: one item and no new or recurring pains. EASTERN ELECTRONICS (THAILAND) is hiring a Chinese-English-Thai interpreter in Amata City, Chonburi. This is a single HR posting and not enough to signal a trend.
